PLAN "12-Week Upper Body Programme: Shoulder-Safe Climber"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build upper-body pulling and pressing strength with pain-free shoulder range"
  GOAL secondary mobility:
    name "Improve scapular control and rotator cuff endurance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Control and Activation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push and Pull Control":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Scapular Pulling":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          inverted_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          prone_T 2x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 1m
          neck_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper and Core":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
